name: newtime_quantize_save_gui
verified_note: Confirmed on FL 26.1.7 at 2560x1440 on 2026-10-29: run end to end after add_warp_markers_gui placed 127 markers (saved the warped file; the marked syllables then sat a median 6.2 ms from their grid lines); the closing click was confirmed by hand. Draft from measured positions on FL 26.1.7 at 2560x1440 (2026-10-29). In the open Newtime window: Snap at row {snap_row} of its menu (1 Beat, 2 1/2, 3 1/3, 4 1/4 beat = a 16th, 5 1/6, 6 1/8), select all, Edit > Quantize time (every warp marker moves to its nearest grid line), then Save sample as {out_path}. Run after add_warp_markers_gui. It closes Newtime at the end (no question is asked) so the playlist clip menu is reachable again.
summary: Quantize Newtime's warp markers to 16ths and save the warped sample.
source: measured on this install; Image-Line manual: Quantize time quantizes warp markers to the grid; Save sample as (Ctrl+S) keeps markers in the file
